gbm_population_evidence.quote: Adult participants, male and female, aged ≥18 who have a pathologically confirmed IDH-wild type glioblastoma, with first or second progression of the tumor, after initial treatment with radiation therapy and temozolomide.

candidate_evidence.quote: recruiting 10 adult patients with recurrent glioblastoma who are assigned to receive the personalized study treatment based on the genetic profile of their recurrent GBM tumor resected at the time of surgery.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Adult participants, male and female, aged ≥18 who have a pathologically confirmed IDH-wild type glioblastoma, with first or second progression of the tumor, after initial treatment with radiation therapy and temozolomide.

role_evidence.quote: Afatinib will be administered orally at a dose of 40 mg daily in patients with EGFR amplification.
Dasatinib will be administered orally at a dose of 100 mg once daily in patients with PDGFR amplification.
Palbociclib will be administered orally at a dose of 125 mg once daily in patients with CDK4 and CDK6 amplification.
Everolimus will be administered orally at a dose of 10 mg daily in patients with PI3K/PTEN/mTOR activated pathways.
Olaparib will be administered orally at a dose of 300 mg twice daily in patients with TP53 mutation.

flag.reason: TP53 mutation is the record's assignment marker for olaparib, but a direct mechanistic link between TP53 and PARP inhibition is not established; adjudicate candidate_matched.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Single arm 'Treatment' in which each patient receives ONE of five drugs assigned by tumour mutation profile and organoid response; each drug is therefore coded experimental_monotherapy (not experimental_combination) and regimen monotherapy. Biomarkers coded enrichment because they determine drug assignment within the arm rather than trial entry; entry requires only IDH-wildtype recurrent GBM. Organoid drug-response testing is ex vivo selection, not target engagement. Trial-level candidate-matched selection is positive regardless of the TP53/olaparib decision.
